name: Media Wipe
author: Md. Nahid Hasan

sections.description:
Media Wipe is a powerful yet simple plugin that allows you to delete all media files from your WordPress Media Library in one click. It’s perfect for cleaning up your site, but use it with caution as the deletion is permanent.

Key Features:

  • Permanently deletes all media files in your Media Library.
  • Delete selected media files.
  • Scan and delete unused media files (Comming Soon).
  • Simple, intuitive interface for quick action.
  • Built-in confirmation prompt to avoid accidental deletions.

Important Notes:

  • This action is irreversible!
  • Always back up your database and files before using Media Wipe.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. For details, visit https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. Upload the plugin to your WordPress site’s /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it directly through the WordPress plugin installer.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to Media > Media Wipe to use the plugin.
sections.faq:
What does this plugin do?

It allows you to delete all, selected, or unused media files in your WordPress Media Library. Deletions include database entries and server files.

Can I undo the deletions?

No, the deletions are permanent. Ensure you have a backup before using this plugin.

Is this plugin safe for live websites?

Yes, but it should be used with caution. Test in a staging environment before using it on a live site.

Does it delete only unused media files?

You now have the option to delete all media, selected media, or unused media files.
